headline: California subpoenas Nvidia over Huang's ties to China
summary: California's attorney general issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia over whether chip exports reached China and whether Nvidia and former CEO Jensen Huang misled investors.

claims.statement: California's attorney general served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia over chip exports to China and Jensen Huang's ties.

sources.quote: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China
California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang’s ties with China

claims.statement: Attorney General Rob Bonta said the conduct of Nvidia and its former CEO may have misled investors.

sources.quote: raises bright red flags, including about the ways in which the company may have misled investors
